Bill.BriefDescription: Creating the Washington state combined fund drive foundation.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the combined fund drive; and adding new sectionsto chapter 41.04 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 41.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The legislature finds that: (a) The Washington state combined fund drive is a valuable asset tothe people of the state of Washington, contributing to their health,education, and well-being; (b) Charitable contributions by state employees and public agencyretirees contribute significantly to the benefit of charities inWashington state and around the world; (c) There is an increasing demand to support charities inWashington state and around the world; (d) There are individuals and groups who desire to contribute tothe continued vitality of the Washington state combined fund drive; and (e) Providing a tax-deductible method for individuals and groups tocontribute is an effective way of increasing available funds to thecharities involved in the Washington state combined fund drive. p. 1 HB 2355 (2) It is in the public interest to create a nonprofit foundationto provide a method for individuals and groups to contribute to thesupport of the beneficiaries of the Washington state combined funddrive. (3) The purpose of the Washington state combined fund drivefoundation is to solicit support for the combined fund drive, cooperatewith other organizations, and encourage gifts to support and reduce theadministrative cost of the combined fund drive.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 41.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The definitions in this section apply throughout this chapterunless the context clearly requires otherwise. (1) "Foundation" means the Washington state combined fund drivefoundation, created in section 3 of this act. (2) "Combined fund drive committee" means the authorized group ofindividuals appointed by the governor to operate the Washington statecombined fund drive. (3) "Eligible grant recipients" includes any and all of theactivities of the Washington state combined fund drive committee whenoperating the state combined fund drive. (4) "Eligible projects" means any project, action, or part of anyproject or action that serves to provide a benefit to the recipients ofthe Washington state combined fund drive.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 41.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) By September 1, 2006, the combined fund drive committee shallfile articles of incorporation in accordance with the Washingtonnonprofit corporation act, chapter 24.03 RCW, to establish theWashington state combined fund drive foundation. The foundation shallnot be an agency, instrumentality, or political subdivision of thestate and shall not disburse public funds. (2) The Washington state combined fund drive committee and thecombined fund drive program manager may provide administrative supportto the Washington state combined fund drive foundation. (3) The foundation must have a board of directors consisting of upto fifteen members. Initial members of the board shall be recommended HB 2355 p. 2 by the director of the department of personnel and the combined funddrive committee for appointment by the governor and collectively haveexperience in business, charitable giving, and fundraising. Initialappointments must be made by September 30, 2006. Subsequent boardmembers shall be elected by the general membership of the foundation. (4) Members of the board serve three-year terms, except for theinitial terms, which must be staggered by the governor to achieve abalanced mix of terms on the board. Members of the board may serve upto a maximum of three terms. At the end of a term, a member maycontinue to serve until a successor has been elected.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 41.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) As soon as practicable, the board of directors shall organizethemselves and the foundation suitably to carry out the duties of thefoundation, including achieving federal tax status. (2) The foundation shall actively solicit contributions fromindividuals and groups for the benefit of the beneficiaries of thecombined fund drive. (3) The foundation shall develop criteria for guiding themselves ineither the creation of an endowment, or making of grants to theWashington state combined fund drive, or both.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 41.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Money provided to the Washington state combined fund drivefoundation may not be used to supplant preexisting funding sources.

If any provision of this act or itsapplication to any person or circumstance is held invalid, theremainder of the act or the application of the provision to otherpersons or circumstances is not affected.
